decisions.statement: A message is acted on once.
The state a run owes the next run is kept outside the repository.
Every action taken on a message is appended to a log.
The rules a run reads are reached from akasha.
A message on a persona channel is decided before any rule sees that message.
A message on a persona channel Alan did not send is left alone rather than acted on.
Each persona is told only the claims made on her own channel.

definition: what becomes of a message that arrives in Alan's inbox
